tools.name: search_products
tools.title: Search the gear on this page
tools.description: Search Northline Outdoor's catalog by name, keyword or category and get matching products with price, variants and stock.

query.description: A product name, keyword or category to search for, e.g. 'rain jacket' or 'tent'.

tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.title: Add a product to the cart
tools.description: Add a product (by SKU, optionally a specific variant) to this visitor's cart on this page. The cart badge and drawer update immediately.

sku.description: The product's SKU code, as shown on its product card (e.g. TRAIL-SHELL).

qty.description: How many to add. Defaults to 1.

variant.description: Optional variant label like 'Moss / M' or 'Slate'. Defaults to the first in-stock variant.

tools.name: view_cart
tools.title: Show the cart
tools.description: Show what's currently in this visitor's cart with line totals, subtotal, shipping and total.

tools.name: check_order_status
tools.title: Check an order
tools.description: Look up an order's status and tracking by order number and the email on the order.

order_number.description: The order number, as printed on the receipt or confirmation email, e.g. '#1042'.

email.description: The email address the order was placed under.

tools.name: start_return
tools.title: Start a return
tools.description: Start a return for an item on an order.

order_number.description: The order number the item was purchased on, e.g. '#1042'.

email.description: The email address the order was placed under.

sku.description: The SKU of the item on that order to return.

reason.description: Why the item is being returned, in the customer's own words.
